==Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.
==Trivia==

* Each time '''Switchblade (Deception)''' attacks, there is a chance to apply [[Effects|Dismember]], making enemies take 25% more [[Damage Affinities / Elements|Physical]] damage. He is the second unit to have this, the first being [[Cursed King]].
* [[Switchblade]] and [[Switchblade (Deception)]] are the third and fourth units in the game who do 100% more damage when they attack with their critical hit, the first and second being [[Lex]] and [[Lex Akoman]].
* At max upgrade, he will deal an average damage per second ( Average DPS ) of '''73,423.34''', which includes both his base damage and the additional average damage his crit will add. His total group DPS ( TDPS ) will be '''220,270.02'''. However, if you have the [[Relics|Endless Blades]] relic equipped and if that relic provides an additional 50% crit chance, then his DPS will increase to '''97,897.79''', raising his total group DPS to '''293,693.36'''. (excluding the 25% physical damage buff from his [[Effects|dismember]])
